adverse housing and neighborhood conditions were not associated with inflammatory markers among middle-aged African Americans.
housing and neighborhood conditions were not associated with pro-inflammatory markers among a sample of middle aged African Americans.

the relationship between neighborhood conditions and inflammatory biomarkers.
the relationship between adverse housing/neighborhood characteristics and inflammatory markers among middle-aged African Americans.
the relationship between housing and neighborhood characteristics and inflammatory markers.

inflammation does not appear to mediate the association between poor neighborhood and housing conditions and adverse health in African Americans.
inflammation is not a mediator of the associations between poor housing and neighborhood conditions and adverse health conditions among middle-aged African Americans.
